summary: Upgrading from 2.4 to 2.6, RPM deployments need extra infrastructure for platform gateway; SAML, LDAP and OIDC settings migrate automatically but IdP callback URLs must point to gateway; controller IAM data moves to gateway.
questions: Do I need more servers when upgrading RPM AAP 2.4 to 2.6?
Do I need to change IdP callback URLs after upgrading to 2.6?
Are SAML and LDAP settings migrated to platform gateway?
